login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your own username. Never share your password or PIN.

notice.pinLockedOut: Too many wrong PINs. Please sign in again with your password.
notice.signedOut: You have been signed out. Please sign in again.

totp.title: Enter the 6-digit code
totp.help: You are signing in from outside the hospital. Open the authenticator app on your phone and type the code shown for HMIS.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.help: Your password was reset by the administrator. Choose a new one that only you know (at least 8 characters).
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.

lock.title: Screen locked
lock.entered: {count, plural, =0 {No digits entered} one {# digit entered} other {# digits entered}}
lock.notYou: Not {name}? Use Switch user to sign in as yourself.

home.title: Welcome, {name}
home.subtitle: Choose what you want to do.
home.setPin: Set a PIN so you can unlock the screen quickly after a break.
home.noTiles: The screens for your work arrive in the next releases.

tiles.usersHint: Create staff accounts, roles, password and PIN resets
tiles.rolesHint: What each role is allowed to do
tiles.workstationsHint: Name and pair shared PCs and tablets
tiles.facilityHint: Hospital name, address and registration numbers
tiles.settingsHint: Rules and switches for the whole hospital
tiles.printHint: Hindi lines, footer, colour and test prints
tiles.mastersHint: Services, rates, doctors, drugs, lab tests, payers

password.title: Change password
password.done: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

pin.title: PIN for quick unlock
pin.help: 4 to 6 digits. Avoid easy PINs like 1111 or 1234. The PIN is also used to approve discounts.

totp.title: Phone code for remote access
totp.help: Needed to sign in from outside the hospital (for example over Tailscale). Install an authenticator app on your phone first.
totp.required: Your role must use this to sign in remotely.
totp.disabled: Phone code is not set up.
totp.scan: Scan this QR code with the app, or type the key below.
totp.qr: QR code for the authenticator app

users.title: Users
users.empty: No users match. Press “New user” to add one.
users.name: Name

userForm.usernameHelp: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Cannot be changed later.
userForm.passwordHelp: Tell the user in person. They must change it at their first sign-in.

userActions.title: Account actions
userActions.resetPasswordHelp: Sets a temporary password, signs the user out everywhere and asks for a new password at the next sign-in.
userActions.resetPinHelp: The user sets a new PIN after the next sign-in.
userActions.clearLockoutHelp: Lifts a password or PIN lockout now instead of waiting.
userActions.resetTotpHelp: For a lost phone. Remote sessions end; the user sets it up again inside the hospital.
userActions.deactivateHelp: The user can no longer sign in. Their records stay. You can reactivate later.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.restrictedNote: MTP permissions are restricted. Give them only by assigning the “MTP doctor” role to a user.
roles.name: Name (English)

workstations.title: Workstations
workstations.help: Pair each shared PC or tablet once, on that device. Prints and the audit trail then show where work was done.
workstations.name: Name (for example Reception 1)

facility.title: Facility profile
facility.help: These details appear in the header of every printed document. Only the name is required.
facility.registrationsHelp: Shown on prints when “show registration numbers” is on in Print header.

settings.title: Settings
settings.help: Rules and switches for the whole hospital. Each change is saved on its own and recorded with your name. “Recommended” means the value suggested for hospitals like yours.
settings.noMatch: No setting matches. Try another word.
settings.jsonInvalid: This is not valid JSON. Check the brackets and quotes.

followUpValidityDays.label: Follow-up valid for (days)
followUpValidityDays.hint: A repeat visit within this many days of the last paid visit counts as a follow-up.

freeFollowUps.label: Free follow-ups
freeFollowUps.hint: How many follow-up visits are free inside the validity period.

followUpRulesByDoctor.label: Follow-up rules per doctor
followUpRulesByDoctor.hint: Advanced. Different validity days and free visits for a particular doctor, as JSON keyed by doctor id. Empty {} = same rule for everyone.

sheetPrintAt.label: Print the OPD sheet at
sheetPrintAt.hint: Where the OPD sheet is printed: at the reception desk, or after vitals are taken.

quickOrders.label: Quick orders per doctor
quickOrders.hint: Advanced. Short lists of frequently used orders per doctor, as JSON keyed by doctor id.

notesRequired.label: Doctor notes required
notesRequired.hint: Do not let a visit be closed until a note is entered.

showNameOnDisplay.label: Show names on the waiting-room TV
showNameOnDisplay.hint: Off: the TV shows token numbers only. On: it also shows first name and initial.

issueTokenBeforePayment.label: Give the token before payment
issueTokenBeforePayment.hint: Off: the token is given after the bill is paid.

roundToRupee.label: Round bills to the nearest rupee
roundToRupee.hint: The difference is shown on the bill as a round-off line.

splitUsgBill.label: Separate bill for ultrasound
splitUsgBill.hint: Make a separate bill for ultrasound scans.

allowOpdCredit.label: Allow OPD bills on credit
allowOpdCredit.hint: Off: OPD bills must be paid in full.

upiRefRequired.label: UPI reference number
upiRefRequired.hint: Advanced. Whether staff must type the UPI reference. mode: off, optional or required_above_amount; abovePaise is in paise.

discountLimits.label: Discount limits by role
discountLimits.hint: Advanced. The most each role can give without approval, as a percentage in basis points (1000 = 10%) and an amount in paise. null = no limit.

refundApprovalAbovePaise.label: Refund needs approval above
refundApprovalAbovePaise.hint: Refunds above this amount need an approver PIN.

depositLowBalancePaise.label: Warn when deposit balance falls below
depositLowBalancePaise.hint: In-patient deposit balance below this amount shows a top-up alert.

packageRoomChange.label: Package when the room category changes
packageRoomChange.hint: How a package is priced if the patient moves to another room category.

bedDayRule.label: How bed days are counted
bedDayRule.hint: Count a bed day at every midnight, or in blocks of 24 hours from admission.

ordersRequireVerify.label: Doctor must verify assistant-entered orders
ordersRequireVerify.hint: In-patient orders typed by an assistant wait for the doctor to verify them.

requireSummaryBeforeFinalBill.label: Discharge summary before final bill
requireSummaryBeforeFinalBill.hint: The final in-patient bill cannot be made until the discharge summary is written.

billing.label: Newborn billing
billing.hint: Charge the newborn on the mother’s bill, or on a separate bill.

verifyMode.label: Doctor checks of typed prescriptions
verifyMode.hint: Off: none. Sample: a share of prescriptions. All: every prescription.

verifySamplePercent.label: Share checked in sample mode (%)
verifySamplePercent.hint: Used only when checks are set to Sample.

requirePhoto.label: Photo of the paper prescription required
requirePhoto.hint: The assistant must attach a photo of the paper prescription.

rxCopy.label: Print typed prescription for the patient
rxCopy.hint: Off: only the paper prescription goes home with the patient.

reportFooter.label: Ultrasound report footer
reportFooter.hint: Text printed at the bottom of every ultrasound report.

patientDeclarationBeforeScan.label: Patient declaration before scan
patientDeclarationBeforeScan.hint: The patient declaration must be recorded before a prenatal scan can start.

blockPatientCharges.label: Block charges to PM-JAY patients
blockPatientCharges.hint: Stop staff from collecting money from patients admitted under PM-JAY.

idleLockMinutes.label: Lock the screen after (minutes)
idleLockMinutes.hint: A screen with no activity locks and asks for the PIN.

maxLoginFailures.label: Wrong passwords before lock
maxLoginFailures.hint: After this many wrong passwords the account is locked for a while.

lockoutMinutes.label: Account lock time (minutes)
lockoutMinutes.hint: How long a locked account waits before trying again.

maxPinFailures.label: Wrong PINs before PIN is blocked
maxPinFailures.hint: After this many wrong PINs the user must sign in with the password.

pinLockoutMinutes.label: PIN block time (minutes)
pinLockoutMinutes.hint: How long PIN unlock stays blocked.

totpRequiredRoles.label: Roles that need a phone code from outside
totpRequiredRoles.hint: These roles must type a code from the authenticator app when signing in from outside the hospital network.

lanNetworks.label: Hospital network addresses
lanNetworks.hint: One per line, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Computers in these networks count as inside the hospital.

enabled.label: WhatsApp messages
enabled.hint: Send reminders and reports through WhatsApp (needs internet and an approved account).

cardiology.label: Cardiology and critical care
cardiology.hint: Switch on the cardiology, ICU and cath lab screens.

trainingMode.label: Training mode
trainingMode.hint: Shows an orange TRAINING banner for practice sessions.

bilingualLabels.label: Roles that see Hindi and English together
bilingualLabels.hint: Screens for these roles show labels as “हिंदी / English”.

print.title: Print header
print.help: The hospital header and footer on every printed document and PDF. English name, address and phone come from the Facility profile.
print.headerHelp: Hindi lines print above the English ones (patient prints are bilingual).

fields.showRegistrationNos: Show registration numbers (registration no., GSTIN) in the header

print.profileNote: Change the English name, address, phone and numbers in
print.colourHelp: Used for the header line on prints and for buttons. Leave neutral if the hospital has no brand colour.
print.testPrintsHelp: Opens a sample document at each paper size so you can check the layout on the real printer. It contains no patient data.

masters.title: Master data
masters.searchPlaceholder: Type a name or short code
masters.truncated: Showing the best matches only. Type more letters to narrow down.
masters.noResults: Nothing matches. Check the spelling or clear the filters.
masters.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded. Please try again.
masters.editHelp: Change the details and press Save.
masters.cancelHelp: Nothing is deleted. The record stays in the history and can be restored.

help.hub: Names, prices and lists that the whole hospital uses. Nothing here is ever deleted: removed items stay in the history.
help.isActive: Switch off to hide it from pick lists without removing it.
help.deptCode: Short capital code, for example GYN. Cannot be changed later.
help.doctorUser: Link to a login if this doctor signs in. Leave blank for visiting doctors.
help.serviceCode: Unique code used in imports and reports. Cannot be changed later.
help.shortCode: Letters staff can type to find this quickly.
help.sacCode: Healthcare services use SAC 9993. Your CA confirms.
help.isExempt: Healthcare services are normally GST exempt. Your CA confirms before go-live.
help.gstPercent: Leave 0 if exempt. For example 5 or 12.5.
help.linkedLab: Connects this service to a lab test so lab orders can be billed.
help.tariffPayer: Leave blank for the default tariff used when a payer has none of its own.
help.effectiveTo: Optional last day. Leave blank if open-ended.
help.creditDays: Days allowed to pay the invoice.
help.payerActive: Only Cash / Self can be switched on for now. Other payers can be prepared but stay off until insurance billing is released.
help.schedule: Legal drug schedule. The pharmacist must set Schedule H, H1 or X correctly before the pharmacy opens.
help.drugGst: GST percent on sale, for example 5 or 12.
help.labUnit: Result unit and ranges are confirmed by the pathologist.
help.formF: When on, a scan on a pregnant woman cannot be finalised without a complete Form F. Keep it on unless the Appropriate Authority advises otherwise.
help.reasonCode: Small letters, digits and underscore. Cannot be changed later.

departments.title: Departments
departments.help: The departments of the hospital. Services and doctors belong to one.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.hint: Doctors, OPD days, consultation fee and follow-up rules
doctors.help: Doctors who see patients. Open a doctor to set consultation services and follow-up rules.

services.title: Services
services.hint: Everything that can appear on a bill
services.help: Consultations, procedures, scans, tests and bed charges. Prices are set under Tariffs → Rates.

tariffs.title: Tariffs and rates
tariffs.hint: Price lists and the price of every service
tariffs.help: A tariff is a price list. Open Rates to enter the price of each service.

payers.title: Payers
payers.hint: Cash, and later PM-JAY, insurance and corporate
payers.help: Who pays the bill. Only Cash / Self is in use now; others are prepared for later.

drugs.title: Drugs
drugs.help: The list used when a prescription is typed in. The starter list is only a beginning: import the real list later.

lab-tests.title: Lab tests
lab-tests.help: Tests that doctors can order. Units and ranges are confirmed by the pathologist.

usg-procedures.title: Ultrasound procedures
usg-procedures.hint: Scan types and Form F rule
usg-procedures.help: Scan types the hospital performs and whether Form F is needed for a pregnant woman.

reason-codes.title: Reasons
reason-codes.hint: Pick lists for discounts, cancellations and refunds
reason-codes.help: Reasons staff pick when giving a discount, cancelling or refunding.

rules.title: Consultation fee and follow-up
rules.help: For each kind of visit choose the service that is billed. Leave validity or free count blank to use the hospital default.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Without a rule the visit type cannot be billed for this doctor.
rules.invalid: Choose a service and use whole numbers for days and counts.

rates.title: Rates: {tariff}
rates.help: The price of each service in this tariff. A new price applies from the date you choose; bills already made keep their old price.
rates.effectiveHelp: Today or a future date. Entering the same date again corrects that day’s rate.
rates.invalidAmount: Enter rupees with up to two decimals, for example 500 or 1250.50.
rates.noRateYet: No rate set yet. This service cannot be billed until a rate is entered.

validation.username: Use 3–40 letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
validation.pinFormat: The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.
validation.pinWeak: This PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid repeated or running digits.
validation.totpFormat: Type the 6 digits shown in the app.
validation.roleKey: Use 3–40 small letters, digits or underscore, starting with a letter.
validation.code: Use capital letters and digits, 2 to 24 characters.
validation.dateOrder: The last date cannot be before the first date.
validation.exemptNoGst: An exempt service has no GST. Set GST to 0 or untick exempt.

mobile.invalid: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notFound: Not found. It may have been changed by someone else; please reload.

auth.mfaRequired: Enter the code from your phone first.
auth.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this. Ask the administrator if you need it.
auth.lockedOut: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, or ask the administrator to unlock your account.
auth.totpNotEnrolled: Signing in from outside the hospital needs the phone code. Set it up from a hospital computer first (My account).
auth.totpInvalid: That code is not right or has expired. Type the newest code from the app.
auth.totpNotStarted: Start the phone code setup again.
auth.totpUnavailable: Phone codes are not configured on this server. Ask the system administrator.
auth.pinLockedOut: Too many wrong PINs. Sign in with your password. The PIN works again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
auth.wrongPin: Wrong PIN. {remaining, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
auth.pinNotSet: No PIN is set. Unlock with your password.
auth.passwordReused: The new password must be different from the current one.
auth.csrf: The page is out of date. Please reload and try again.

admin.usernameTaken: This username is already used. Choose another.
admin.lastUserManager: This would leave nobody who can manage users. Give another active user that permission first.
admin.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
admin.restrictedPermission: MTP permissions cannot be changed here. Assign the “MTP doctor” role instead.
admin.roleKeyTaken: A role with this key already exists.
admin.workstationNameTaken: A workstation with this name already exists.
admin.ownerOnly: Only the owner can do this for owner or MTP accounts and roles.
admin.settingNotEditable: This setting cannot be changed here.

masters.badReference: A linked item was not found or has been removed. Choose it again.
masters.invalid: Please check the values and try again.
masters.cancelled: This item was removed. Restore it first to change it.
masters.codeTaken: This code is already used. Codes of removed items are also reserved.
masters.inUse: Still in use by active doctors, services or tariffs. Move or remove those first.
masters.doctorUserTaken: This login is already linked to another doctor.
masters.payerPhase: Only Cash / Self can be switched on for now. Prepare other payers switched off.
masters.selfPayerProtected: Cash / Self is needed for billing and cannot be removed or switched off.
masters.defaultTariffProtected: There must always be one active default tariff.
masters.drugTaken: A drug with the same name, strength, form and maker already exists.

groups.comingSoon: The screens for this work area arrive in the next releases.

reception.hint: Register patients, give tokens, manage the queue

assistant.hint: Enter prescriptions and notes from the doctor’s paper

billing.hint: Bills, payments, deposits and day close

doctor.hint: Patients waiting, prescriptions to verify, discharge

nursing.hint: Bed board, charts and medicine rounds

print.title: Print: {name}
print.nextIsOriginal: This will be the original copy.
print.nextIsDuplicate: Already printed before. This will be copy {n} and is marked DUPLICATE.
